# Pliego

> Pliego is MADFAM's platform for sheet hyperobjects — origami, kirigami, papercut, pop-up and paper engineering, book structures and interactive paper dioramas — with real paper physics. Status: incubating (in development, not yet a product).

*Pliego* (Spanish): a sheet of paper folded in the middle — the printer's sheet that, folded and cut, becomes a book's signature.

## What it does

- Describes every paper object by its flat sheet (outline, cuts, mountain/valley creases, scores, perforations, glue tabs) plus a fold program, as a sheet document: a FOLD 1.2 file with `pliego:` extensions.
- Simulates it in the browser and in Node with a deterministic engine: rigid kinematics for mechanisms and rigid origami, compliant physics with the stiffness, grain, crease memory and springback of the actual paper stock.
- Exports cut, score and fold files for laser cutters, drag-knife plotters and print, plus folding diagrams in English, Spanish, French and Portuguese.

## Pages

- [Landing](https://pliego.madfam.io/): what Pliego is, in four languages (`?lang=en|es|fr|pt`).
- [Studio](https://pliego-app.madfam.io/studio/): interactive viewer — catalog, parameters, fold-program scrubber, 3-D view (WebGL2, Canvas 2D fallback) and crease-pattern diagram. Share links: `?slug=<object>#<param>=<value>`.

## Family

- Yantra4D: solid parts (Pliego references hardware such as brads through `hardware_ref`).
- Fashion Cabinet: garments and fabrics (book cloth, ribbon).

## Licences

- Platform code: AGPL-3.0-only, © Innovaciones MADFAM S.A.S. de C.V.
- Commons objects and paper stock cards (`sheet-hyperobjects`): CERN-OHL-W-2.0.

## Status

Incubating: built in the open, not yet deployed as a product. No prices are published.
